tokens.name: --bg
tokens.description: App canvas behind every page. Never put body text directly on it in dense areas; use surface.

tokens.name: --surface
tokens.description: Cards, tables, panels, sidebar. The default container for content.

tokens.name: --surface-sunken
tokens.description: Wells inside a surface: code blocks, tool-call output, table header row, input groups.

tokens.name: --surface-hover
tokens.description: Hover state for rows, nav items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: --border
tokens.description: Default 1px hairline for cards, inputs, table rows. Borders, not shadows, separate in-flow content.

tokens.name: --border-strong
tokens.description: Input and control borders (3:1 against surface), emphasized dividers.

tokens.name: --fg
tokens.description: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: --fg-muted
tokens.description: Secondary text: descriptions, table metadata, labels. Legible on bg, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: --fg-subtle
tokens.description: Placeholders, timestamps, captions. 4.5:1 on surface in both themes; avoid on surface-sunken for long text.

tokens.name: --primary
tokens.description: The one primary action per view, links, selected nav, focus. Pair text on it with on-primary.

tokens.name: --primary-hover
tokens.description: Hover/pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: --on-primary
tokens.description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: --primary-soft
tokens.description: Selected rows, active nav item background, info banners.

tokens.name: --primary-text

tokens.name: --agent
tokens.description: Agent identity and progress. Pair with a descriptive label or icon.

tokens.name: --on-agent
tokens.description: Text and icons on an agent fill.

tokens.name: --agent-text

tokens.name: --danger
